requirements.candidate_label: Cover conflicting intersection devices in a closed directional roadway
requirements.subject: Existing WRONG WAY signs, markings, and other conflicting traffic-control devices at intersections within the closed directional roadway
requirements.relation: shall be covered, removed, or obliterated
requirements.threshold: No inapplicable conflicting device remains exposed within the temporary closure/intersection area
applicability_conditions: An intersection lies within the temporary two-lane/two-way operations or closure area
required_inputs: Field inventory of existing intersection traffic-control devices
requirements.source_span: When a directional roadway is closed, inapplicable WRONG WAY signs and markings, and other existing traffic control devices at intersections within the temporary two-lane, two-way operations section shall be covered, removed, or obliterated.
missing_inputs: Field inventory of existing intersection traffic-control devices
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect scoped temporal images and accepted observations for existing intersection devices, then establish the closure and intersection limits from image-supported roadway landmarks and trajectory.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Assess compliance only if the inventory and limits can identify every applicable existing device within the closure/intersection area; otherwise report unresolved.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.03 01: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions
requirements.subject: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions,
requirements.threshold: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.
requirements.source_span: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions, should be located in advance of the work space or any detour, on the road where the work is taking place.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect and, if possible, measure the visible ROAD WORK AHEAD signs relative to the established work-space or detour reference.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Assess location only when both sign identity and its advance relationship to the work space/detour are evidenced; otherwise unresolved.

requirements.subject: The DETOUR (W20-2) sign (see Figure 6H-1)
requirements.threshold: The DETOUR (W20-2) sign (see Figure 6H-1) should be used in advance of a road user detour over a different roadway or route.
requirements.source_span: The DETOUR (W20-2) sign (see Figure 6H-1) should be used in advance of a road user detour over a different roadway or route.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the scoped temporal images for a DETOUR (W20-2) sign and determine whether it is used in advance of the confirmed off-site detour; note that the off-site route itself is outside camera scope.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Report compliant only if image evidence clearly shows the required W20-2 use in advance of the applicable detour; otherwise report unresolved or unsupported, not inferred from detour confirmation alone.

requirements.candidate_label: TABLE-6B-1 table: advance warning sign dimensions A, B, and C
requirements.subject: advance warning sign dimensions A, B, and C
requirements.threshold: Urban low speed: A=100 ft, B=100 ft, C=100 ft; urban high speed: A=350 ft, B=350 ft, C=350 ft; rural: A=500 ft, B=500 ft, C=500 ft; expressway/freeway: A=1,000 ft, B=1,500 ft, C=2,640 ft. A is restriction-to-first-sign distance, B first-to-second, and C second-to-third.
applicability_conditions: road type and agency-determined speed category
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-1. Recommended Advance Warning Sign Minimum Spacing. Urban (low speed): 100 feet, 100 feet, 100 feet. Urban (high speed): 350 feet, 350 feet, 350 feet. Rural: 500 feet, 500 feet, 500 feet. Expressway / Freeway: 1,000 feet, 1,500 feet, 2,640 feet. The column headings A, B, and C are the dimensions shown in Figures 6P-1 through 6P-54.

measurement_spec.quantity: spacing between successive advance warning signs

thresholds.condition: urban low-speed advance warning sign spacing

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect temporal images to establish sign identities and sequence, then measure longitudinal spacing using the ego trajectory and lidar-supported sign positions where available; classify the roadway and applicable Table 6B-1 category only from supported facts.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Apply the urban low-speed 100-foot criterion only if roadway type/category and successive applicable signs are established; otherwise leave the spacing predicate unresolved.

requirements.candidate_label: TA-19 08: When used, the Street Name sign
requirements.subject: When used, the Street Name sign
requirements.threshold: When used, the Street Name sign shall be placed above the Detour sign. Sect. 6P.01 December 2023 MUTCD 11th Edition Page 897
requirements.source_span: When used, the Street Name sign shall be placed above the Detour sign. Sect. 6P.01 December 2023 MUTCD 11th Edition Page 897
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the scoped images for any Street Name sign and any Detour sign, then evaluate their vertical arrangement when both are present.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: If a Street Name sign is clearly used, require it to be above the Detour sign; if no Street Name sign is used, treat the conditional placement as not applicable; ambiguous imagery remains unresolved.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 02: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (
requirements.subject: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign
requirements.threshold: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the time-ordered approach images for all advance-warning signs and establish their encounter order, with particular attention to ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1).
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Find compliance only when multiple advance-warning signs and their first-encounter order are visually established; otherwise report unresolved.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 01: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs
requirements.subject: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs
requirements.threshold: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs should be placed in advance of the transition and activity areas at varying distances depending on roadway type, condition, and posted speed. Table 6B-1 contains information regarding the spacing of advance warning signs. Where a series of two or more advance warning signs is used, the closest sign to the transition and activity areas should be placed approximately 100 feet for low-speed urban streets to 1,000 feet or more for freeways and expressways.
requirements.source_span: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs should be placed in advance of the transition and activity areas at varying distances depending on roadway type, condition, and posted speed. Table 6B-1 contains information regarding the spacing of advance warning signs. Where a series of two or more advance warning signs is used, the closest sign to the transition and activity areas should be placed approximately 100 feet for low-speed urban streets to 1,000 feet or more for freeways and expressways.

measurement_spec.quantity: longitudinal distance from the closest advance-warning sign to the transition/activity area

thresholds.condition: closest advance-warning sign before an established transition/activity area

requirements.planned_evidence_strategy: Inspect the approach images to identify the closest advance-warning sign and establish the transition/activity reference, then measure their longitudinal separation using trajectory and lidar-supported positions.
requirements.planned_decision_rule: Use the approximately 100-foot low-speed urban criterion only when the closest sign and transition/activity area are both established; otherwise leave unresolved.
